March 14, 2027
Ms. Amara Okafor\ 18 Cedar Road\ Hartley, NY 12998
## Offer of admission: B.S. in Computer Science
Application reference LV-2027-04817
Dear Amara,
Congratulations. On behalf of the admissions committee, it is my pleasure to offer you a place in the four-year B.S. in Computer Science program at Linden Vale University. Your application was one of the strongest we read this year.
We are also delighted to tell you that you have been awarded the Founders Scholarship, which covers your full tuition for all four years.
**Program:** B.S. in Computer Science (four years, full time)\ **Starts:** August 30, 2027\ **Tuition:** Covered in full by the Founders Scholarship\ **Reply by:** May 1, 2027
The offer is conditional on your final transcript: you must complete your senior year with a B average or better, including Mathematics. The scholarship continues each year that you remain in good academic standing.
To accept, sign in to the applicant portal at [apply.lindenvale.example](https://apply.lindenvale.example) and choose Accept offer. If you have questions, reply to this letter or write to [admissions@lindenvale.example](mailto:admissions@lindenvale.example).
We hope to welcome you in August.
Sincerely,
**Dr. Helen Marsh**\ Director of Admissions
